objective: general stable natural-posture end-to-end whole-body 6D EE/TCP tracking

initialization_diagnosis.root_cause: The previous PPO objective had no explicit default-leg, hip, left-right symmetry, or roll terms, so the actor repeatedly commanded a wide asymmetric stance.

continuous_speed_sweep.note: The deterministic PLAY configuration disables random perturbations and assigns trajectories by environment index, so the three seed results are identical.

door_pull.note: Keep model_625 as the scripted-door checkpoint; door success is no longer the primary model-selection objective.

rejected_or_secondary_checkpoints.model_711: 766/768 mixed completion with worse tracking than model_700
rejected_or_secondary_checkpoints.model_724: 766/768 mixed completion; more natural 9-degree maximum settling hip deviation but two boundary failures

known_limitations: Extreme low-front targets still need explicit self-collision distance or a constrained safety layer.
